cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Stay for the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: About the reunion: please don't explain my late arrival as traffic. I was outside for half an hour. Let me explain it properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I saved you a seat. I thought you didn't want to sit with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the wrong conclusion. I wanted that seat. I saw you laughing with everyone and couldn't make myself come in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was telling them about our camping trip. I wanted you there to finish the story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please don't dismiss this: I thought you'd be happier without me. Will you sit with me while I tell you how long I've believed that?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1/A3 correct benign explanations, but A5 becomes an ordinary request not to be dismissed; the only-qualified professional method is no longer distinctive enough.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's rejection reading earns A3's explanation; B4's shared-story revelation causes A5's deeper admission and support test.

relationship.evidence: B4 supplies a concrete reason A was wanted and remains emotionally available.

heightening.evidence: A5 risks revealing how long the exclusion fear has lasted in response to B4's reassuring fact.
